title: +*INTRODUCTION TO ASIAN AMERICAN STUDIES
description: Explores the interdisciplinary field of Asian American Studies with an emphasis on the histories and experiences of Asian Americans from the 1800s to the present. Examines a variety of source material including scholarly texts, oral histories, personal essays, media, and creative writing.
